concerns.text: The primary SC‑006 metric is defined as an ablation‑based ΔR² share computed by removing SHAP interaction contributions from the *already‑trained* non‑linear model. Zeroing SHAP interaction values does not correspond to a model that was trained without those interactions, so the resulting ΔR² does not validly quantify the proportion of variance *attributable* to interactions. This threatens construct validity of the interaction‑variance claim.

SHAP interaction values are used for ranking pairwise effects, yet the plan does not specify any statistical control for multicollinearity among descriptors (e.g., temperature vs. inverse temperature, compositional descriptors vs. microstructural proxies). Without addressing collinearity, interaction importance may be confounded, undermining the validity of the reported interaction contribution.

The a‑priori power analysis assumes a minimum sample size of ≥ 200 samples, but the plan acknowledges that no verified open dataset currently exists (Scope‑Correction). Power analysis based on simulated data cannot guarantee that the real dataset will meet the assumed effect‑size distribution, making the power claim speculative and potentially unsound.
